subject: Supplier registration + equity & sustainability kickoff for BlueHarbor
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@blueharborfoods.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — kickoff and supplier forms

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this — BlueHarbor is moving forward with Redwood for ingredient traceability APIs and we need to complete your vendor setup so we can issue the first PO (PO-99214). Procurement asked me to run through the onboarding checklist and collect our standard supply-chain ESG documentation during setup (our compliance team is focused on modern slavery and supplier diversity).

Can you confirm what you need from us to:
- Complete the supplier registration and bank setup
- Verify diversity certifications (minority/woman-owned, if applicable)
- Provide modern slavery / sustainability questionnaires and insurance certificates

We can share W-9, bank ACH info, and insurance certs on a secure link — what's the preferred flow at Redwood? Also curious about payment terms cadence and any minimum PO requirements.

Appreciate a short checklist and expected timeline so I can loop legal and finance on our side.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Senior Procurement Manager
BlueHarbor Foods
procure@blueharborfoods.com
(415) 555-0187

Attachment: none in initial request
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@blueharborfoods.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — kickoff and supplier forms

Hi Aisha — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the clear ask. Below is our suggested onboarding checklist and where we'd like documents. I copied Monica (procurement ops) to run the DocuSign/vendor master flow and Rishi for any legal/compliance clarifications.

Redwood supplier onboarding checklist (target: complete in 5–7 business days)
1) Supplier registration form — fill and sign (DocuSign link to follow). Required fields: legal name, tax ID, bank ACH details for payments, primary contact for support.
2) Tax & corporate docs — W-9 (US) or W-8BEN (if applicable). Send scanned PDF on our secure intake or via the DocuSign envelope.
3) Insurance — COI (certificate of insurance). We need liability limits; please include broker contact.
4) Modern slavery & ESG questionnaire — we have a short Excel questionnaire attached (Modern_Slavery_Compliance_Questionnaire.xlsx). Please complete sections A–D (supply chain risk, policies, audits, remediation).
5) Supplier diversity — if BlueHarbor has any diversity certifications (MBE/WBE/DBE/etc.), please attach copies. If not, please indicate status in the questionnaire.
6) Contract / PO terms — see attached Redwood_PO_Terms_v2.pdf for standard net-45 payment terms and liability clauses. If you need different terms, flag now; procurement/legal will review.

Preferred file flow: we will send a DocuSign envelope for the Supplier Registration + ACH authorization. For sensitive docs (banking, W-9), use the DocuSign or our encrypted intake SFTP link (I will include the link in the follow-up). Non-sensitive docs (ESG questionnaire, certs) can be uploaded to the Drive link below.

I attached: Redwood_Supplier_Registration_Form.pdf (preview), Modern_Slavery_Compliance_Questionnaire.xlsx, Redwood_PO_Terms_v2.pdf.

Next steps:
- Monica will initiate DocuSign (same day) with the registration and ACH authorization.
- Complete the ESG questionnaire and upload to the Drive link or return via email if you prefer.
- Once signed and verified, finance will set up the supplier record and issue PO-99214.

Monica / Rishi — any additional must-haves from ops or legal?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Registration_Form.pdf (stub), Modern_Slavery_Compliance_Questionnaire.xlsx (stub), Redwood_PO_Terms_v2.pdf (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@blueharborfoods.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — kickoff and supplier forms

Thanks Karthik — sending DocuSign now. A couple of operational notes for BlueHarbor:
- DocuSign envelope will include: Supplier Registration PDF + ACH Authorization. Please sign both.
- For W-9 and COI, you can either attach them in DocuSign or upload to the Drive folder — we prefer DocuSign for bank wiring details.
- Modern slavery questionnaire: please complete tab A–D and return. We will use answers to route any high-risk suppliers to our compliance team for a short follow-up audit.
- Diversity: if you have certification PDFs, add them to the Drive folder. We award diversity-weighted scoring during vendor selection for community programs.

Estimated timeline from our side: once signed and documents uploaded, supplier record creation typically takes 48–72 hours, after which PO issuance begins (we can expedite if needed). If BlueHarbor needs net-30, let us know and include a point of contact for billing to speed internal approvals.

Aisha — sending DocuSign envelope (DocuSign ID: ABC12345-BlueHarbor-Onboarding). I'll follow up when the envelope is completed.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: DocuSign envelope referenced (no file attached to this message)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@blueharborfoods.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — kickoff and supplier forms

Aisha — quick follow-up after Monica's note. Two small items to call out so we don't hit surprises:
1) Data handling: because Redwood will host tokens of PII for vendor billing contacts, our privacy checklist requests a named contact for any data subject requests and the region where the vendor is incorporated. Please indicate US/CA/EU in the questionnaire.
2) Escalations: if there are any SLAs we need to trade off (latency vs cost) for the API service, flag that now so we can propose a tiered PO (standard vs priority).

If everything looks ok, please complete the DocuSign envelope and the Modern Slavery questionnaire today so Monica can create the supplier record tomorrow and finance can process PO-99214.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting BlueHarbor live.

Karthik
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
